column1: # Pre-registered manifest — editing fixtures under the PLURAL emission
# follow-up. Written BEFORE the first cell of this arm.
# NOT an amendment to experiment-manifest-editing-n20.tsv, which is complete and
# closed at 60 rows. This is a separate arm against a CHANGED INSTRUMENT: the
# repair emission follow-up in main.swift was rewritten from singular ("the file
# you just diagnosed… one fenced code block") to plural-but-count-free ("for
# each file you just diagnosed… however many that is"). Everything else —
# fixtures, reference tree, acceptance suite, oracle, runner, variant, rounds —
# is unchanged.
# WHAT IT TESTS. Block B's failure taxonomy attributed 10 of 18 failures to the
# singular wording: the model diagnosed both/all broken files, then emitted only
# one, and round 2 re-emitted the same one. If that reading is right, the
# multi-file fixtures should improve sharply and the single-file control should
# not move.
# PRIMARY endpoint, fixed in advance: the POOLED multi-file rate (depth-2 +
# depth-3, n=24) against Block B's pooled multi-file baseline of 20/37 = 54%.
# Pooling is pre-registered because it is the only comparison this arm has the
# power to settle at n=12 per fixture; per-fixture rates are SECONDARY and will
# be reported with intervals, not adjudicated.
# CONTROL: plausible-wrong-fix (1 file) at n=6. It scored 95% in Block B and has
# no second file to drop, so the fix should leave it alone. A drop here means
# the new wording broke something, and the arm fails rather than succeeds.
# This is a SCREEN, not a confirmation. n=12 per fixture can detect a large
# effect and cannot resolve a small one. If the pooled rate does not move, that
# is informative; if it moves a little, the honest answer is "underpowered" and
# the next step is a larger pre-registration, not a re-read of these numbers.
# DECISION RULE, fixed before the first cell (two-sided Fisher exact against the
# 20/37 baseline; k = passes out of 24 multi-file cells):
#   k >= 20  (>=83%)  p <= 0.027  -> SUPPORTS the fix; the taxonomy's claim that
#                                    ~10/18 failures were harness-amplified stands
#   k == 18-19        p ~ 0.11    -> suggestive but UNDERPOWERED; do not claim a
#                                    win. Next step is a larger pre-registration
#   k <= 16  (<=67%)  p >= 0.43   -> NO detectable effect; the singular-wording
#                                    reading is wrong or minor, and the failures
#                                    are the model's, not the harness's
# The control must stay high: plausible-wrong-fix below 4/6 is a regression
# signal and voids the arm regardless of what the multi-file cells did.
# Seeds deliberately REUSE Block B's 4-15 (and 4-9 for the control) so the two
# arms differ in the instrument rather than in the seed set. Different results
# file, so nothing in Block B is re-run or overwritten.
